SIKA® VISCOCRETE®-5-500: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sika_viscocrete_-5-500.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 is a third generation superplasticiser used to produce soft plastic concrete as well as state of the art, self compacting concrete (SCC) depending on the dose rate.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 is ideal for the production of high performance concrete. It facilitates extremely high water reduction or highly flowable concrete for easy placement. Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 is used for the following types of concrete:
    - Precast concrete
    - Concrete requiring high water reduction
    - High strength concrete
    - Self compacting concrete (SCC)
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: HWR – High Range Water Reducer
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for High Range Water Reducing Admixture (HWR).
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500, the following concrete properties are obtained :
    - High workability, flowability and finishability
    - Extremely high water reduction can be achieved, resulting in high early strength concrete.
    - Improved shrinkage and creep behaviour can be observed.
    - Excellent flow can also be achieved resulting in better placement and compaction of the concrete.
    - Suitable for the production of Self Compacting Concrete or super workable concrete.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Mixture of modified polycarboxylates
    - Appearance and colour: Clear brown liquid
    - Specific gravity: 1.07 g/cm³
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 205 litre drum; 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers, protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is at least one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C protected from the direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 can be used in conjunction with all the Sika Concrete Admixtures, except Sikament NN.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage for soft concrete production is 300mls-600mls per 100kg of total cementitious material. For self compacting concrete, typical dosage is 700mls-1000mls per 100kg of total cementitious material.
4.4 Dispensing. Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 is added together with the batching water. For optimum utilisation of the high range water reduction we recommend thorough mixing at a minimum wet mixing time of 60 seconds per cubic metre after the admixture addition. Do not add to a dry mix.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 actual setting time will depend on site conditions. This should be checked and predetermined beforehand with trial mixes.
    - Special mix design is required to achieve Self Compacting Concrete (SCC).
4.6 Further information.
    - May slightly increase air content of concrete at normal dose.
    - Do not mix with naphthalene based admixtures.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 actual setting time will depend on site conditions. This should be checked and predetermined beforehand with trial mixes.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sika_viscocrete_-5-500.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500, version 07/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sds-sika-viscocrete-5-500.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika ViscoCrete 5-500, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/MSDS%20Sika%20ViscoCrete%C2%AE%205-500%20GHS7.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/epd-sika-viscocrete-5-500.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
